caption: Korean fried chicken for 1€? Yes, you heard that right 🍗👀 @dakju.chicken is having special deal for their opening Saturday (09.08). If you are around, definitely stop by and show them some love 🌸 📍 Schulstraße 42, 80634 München ⏰ from 12:00 PM on first come, first served! #koreanfoodmunich;#dakjuchicken;#koreanischesessen;#munichfoodie;#foodinmuc

Best Christmas markets in Munich 2025! 🎄✨ Marienplatz is the classic, but don't miss the medieval market at Wittelsbacher Platz and the romantic one at Sendlinger Tor.  Glühwein tastes better when it's snowing ❄️ #munichChristmas;#christkindlmarkt;#winterinmunich;#gluhwein

Specialty Coffee Spots in Munich 🌿✨ Sharing my go-to places for all coffee lovers 👇 Rocco Junior, Calima, Southbank, gangundgäbe, Kanso, Kyso, Stray, Man vs Machine.  Can't go wrong with any of them 🌞 #specialitycoffee;#coffeeinmunich;#coffeeholic

Hidden gem alert! 🥐 Café Frischhut has the best Schmalzgebäck in town. Go early before they sell out.  Locals line up here every morning!  📍 Prälat-Zistl-Straße 8 #frischhut;#schmalzgebäck;#munichemssan;#breakfastinmunich
Sunset views from Olympiapark tower are unbeatable 🌅 Book tickets online and go 1 hour before sunset. The whole city glows!  #olympiapark;#munichsunset;#olympiaturm;#viewpoint

Viktualienmarkt on a Saturday morning >> everything else.  Fresh flowers, Bavarian cheese, pretzels bigger than your head 🥨 Don't leave without trying Obazda! #viktualienmarkt;#marketday;#munichfood;#obazda

Englischer Garten in autumn 🍂 Rent a bike, grab a radler at the Chinese Tower beer garden, watch the Eisbach surfers. Perfect Saturday.  #englischergarten;#eisbachwelle;#chinesetower;#beergarden;#bikeride
Late night ramen at Takumi 🍜 The best cure after a long day.  Always busy but worth the wait. Try the spicy miso!  📍 Barer Straße 68 #ramen;#takumiramen;#mucfood;#latenightfood

Nymphenburg Palace gardens are magical in spring 🌸 Bring a picnic, explore the hidden pavilions, and don't miss the swan boats. Free entry to the park!  #nymphenburg;#schloss;#springinmunich;#picnicspot
Brunch at Cotidiano = always a good idea 🥞 Their shakshuka and banana bread are 10/10. Weekend waits can be long so book ahead!  #brunchinmunich;#cotidiano;#weekendvibes
You NEED to try the Käsespätzle at Augustiner am Dom 🧀 Creamy, cheesy, perfect after a day exploring Marienplatz. This place never disappoints! #augustiner;#kasespatzle;#bavarianfood;#munichfoodie

Christmas market season!  🎄✨ The Wittelsbacher Platz medieval market has the BEST handmade gifts and the mulled wine is so good. Go at night for the full vibe! #christmasmarket;#wittelsbacherplatz;#munichChristmas;#gluhwein
Best pizza in Munich?  It's @grantino.pizza in Schwabing 🍕 The crust is *chef's kiss* and they use local ingredients. Try the truffle pizza! #pizza;#schwabing;#munichpizza;#grantino
Café Lotti for the cutest pastries and cappuccino art ☕🥐 Their almond croissant is life-changing. Perfect spot to work or catch up with friends! #cafelotti;#munichcafe;#pastry;#coffeetime
Rooftop drinks at Brenner Grill with a view of the opera house 🍸 Fancy but worth it for special occasions.  Sunset time is magical! #brenner;#rooftopbar;#munichviews;#fancynight
Viktualienmarkt haul 🛒 Fresh flowers, artisan bread, the best olives, and a pretzel for the road. This market is my happy place! #viktualienmarkt;#marketday;#freshfood;#munichlife
Brunch goals at Ruffini 🥞🍳 Big portions, cozy vibe, and the best scrambled eggs.  Go on a Sunday and thank me later! #ruffini;#brunch;#sundayvibes;#munichbrunch
Street food Thursday at Olympiapark!  🌮🍔 So many food trucks, live music, and good vibes.  Bring friends and try everything! #streetfood;#olympiapark;#foodtrucks;#thursdaynight
Hidden gem:  Eataly München 🇮🇹 Fresh pasta, Italian wines, and a rooftop terrace.  It's like a mini vacation to Italy without leaving Munich! #eataly;#italianfood;#munichfood;#pastanight
Craft beer heaven at Giesinger Bräu 🍺 Try the flight to taste all their brews. The taproom is cozy and the staff knows their stuff!  #giesingerbrau;#craftbeer;#munichbeer;#brewery

Eisbach surfing on a random Tuesday 🏄‍♂️ Only in Munich can you surf in the middle of a city park. Watching is free, trying it?  Brave souls only! #eisbachwelle;#surfing;#englischergarten;#munichvibes
BMW Museum is actually super cool 🚗 Even if you're not a car person.  The architecture alone is worth it!  #bmwmuseum;#museum;#munichculture;#bmwwelt
Night swimming at Müllersches Volksbad 🏊‍♀️ This Art Nouveau pool is stunning. Open late on Tuesdays and Thursdays.  A Munich must-do! #mullerschesvolksbad;#swimming;#artnouveau;#nightswim
Flea market Sunday at Zenith!  🛍️ Vintage clothes, vinyl records, antique furniture.  Bring cash and arrive early for the best finds! #fleamarket;#vintage;#zenith;#sundaymarket
Hofbräuhaus = tourist trap but also kinda fun?  🍺 Go once, drink a Mass, sing along, check it off the list. Just don't expect authentic Munich vibes lol #hofbrauhaus;#touristlife;#beer;#munich
Sunset hike to Olympiaberg 🌄 Best free viewpoint in the city.  Bring a picnic and watch the sky turn pink over Munich! #olympiaberg;#sunset;#hiking;#freeactivity
Deutsches Museum = nerdy heaven 🤓 You could spend days here.  The aviation section and the mining exhibit are mind-blowing! #deutschesmuseum;#science;#museum;#munichculture
Glockenbachviertel bar hopping 🍹 Start at NY Club, hit up Niederlassung, end at Zephyr. Best nightlife area that's not too touristy! #glockenbachviertel;#nightlife;#bars;#munichnight

Christmas market at Sendlinger Tor has the best vibes 🎅 Less crowded than Marienplatz, better food stalls, and cute wooden huts. My favorite!  #christmasmarket;#sendlingertor;#munichChristmas;#wintervibes
Flaucher river beach day ☀️ Bring a cooler, a portable grill, and your best friends. Summer in Munich doesn't get better than this! #flaucher;#isar;#riverbeach;#summerfun
Golden hour at Nymphenburg 🌅 The palace gardens are free and basically never crowded. Perfect for a peaceful evening walk! #nymphenburg;#goldenhour;#palace;#munichlife
Coffee and cake at Café Glockenspiel ☕🍰 Best view of Marienplatz from the terrace. The Apfelstrudel is *amazing*! #cafeglockenspiel;#marienplatz;#coffeetime;#apfelstrudel
Residenz München is SO underrated 👑 Fewer tourists than Nymphenburg, just as impressive.  The treasury room is incredible! #residenz;#palace;#munichhistory;#hidden gem
Picnic essentials from Viktualienmarkt 🧺 Fresh bread, local cheese, strawberries, and a bottle of wine. Head to the Isar after! #viktualienmarkt;#picnic;#isar;#munichsummer
Alte Pinakothek on a rainy day 🎨 Old Masters paintings and it's so quiet inside. Admission is only €1 on Sundays! #altepinakothek;#art;#museum;#rainydays
Chinese Tower beer garden in full bloom 🌸🍺 1 liter of beer, a pretzel, and good company. This is peak Munich right here! #chinesetower;#beergarden;#englischergarten;#springtime
Sunset from St. Peter's Church tower 🌇 Climb the 299 steps for the BEST view in Munich. Go 1 hour before sunset!  #stpeterskirche;#tower;#munichviews;#sunset
Schloss Blutenburg feels like a fairy tale 🏰 Way out of the city center but worth the trip.  Bring a book and relax by the water! #schlossblutenburg;#castle;#hiddenmunich;#fairytale
Karls Erdbeerhof in December = Christmas heaven!  🎄 Huge market, kids' rides, roasted almonds, and the best Glühwein. Family-friendly and fun! #karlserdbeerhof;#christmasmarket;#familyfun;#december
Brunch at Occam Deli 🥯 Everything is fresh and made in-house. The sourdough sandwiches are to die for! #occamdeli;#brunch;#sandwich;#munichfood
Isar river sunset 🌅 Grab a blanket, some snacks, and just sit by the water. Costs nothing and it's one of the best things about living here! #isar;#sunset;#riverview;#freemunich
Best gelato?  Bar Centrale!  🍦 The pistachio is unreal. Always a line but it moves fast. Right near Gärtnerplatz!  #gelato;#barcentrale;#gaertnerplatz;#sweettooth
Dinner at Pageou 🍽️ Modern Bavarian cuisine with a Michelin star. The tasting menu is pricey but unforgettable.  Book weeks in advance! #pageou;#michelinstar;#finedining;#munichfood
Takumi for late night ramen cravings 🍜 Always packed but always worth it. The tonkotsu is my go-to! #takumiramen;#ramen;#latenight;#mucfoodie
Westpark in cherry blossom season 🌸 Less tourists than Englischer Garten and just as beautiful. Great for photos! #westpark;#cherryblossom;#spring;#munichparks
Asam Church is a hidden baroque gem 💎 Free entry, super ornate, and right in the city center. Most people walk past without noticing! #asamkirche;#baroque;#church;#hiddengem
Morning run through Englischer Garten 🏃‍♀️ Start at the Chinese Tower, loop past Kleinhesseloher See, finish at Eisbach. Best way to start the day! #running;#englischergarten;#morningrun;#fitness
Brunch heaven at Holy Home 🥑☕ Avocado toast, açaí bowls, and the best flat whites.  Instagrammable AF! #holyhome;#brunch;#avocadotoast;#munichbrunch
Tollwood Winter Festival is ON! 🎪 Live music, food stalls from around the world, and a huge market. Go multiple times! #tollwood;#winterfestival;#munichevents;#december
Kunsthalle München for contemporary art 🎨 Rotating exhibitions, always something new. The current one is incredible! #kunsthallemunchen;#contemporaryart;#exhibition;#art
Alter Hof courtyard is so peaceful 🏛️ Right in the busy center but feels like a secret spot. Great for a quick break! #alterhof;#courtyard;#historicmunich;#quietplace
Pasta workshop at Eataly 🍝 Learned to make fresh ravioli and it was SO fun.  They do classes every weekend! #eataly;#pastacooking;#workshop;#italianfood
Midnight bike ride through the city 🚴‍♂️ Empty streets, cool breeze, total freedom. Munich hits different at night! #bikeride;#nightride;#munichnight;#cityvibes
Schwabing street art tour 🎨 So many cool murals in the side streets. Bring your camera and explore! #schwabing;#streetart;#urbanart;#munichstreets
Augustiner Bräustuben for authentic Bavarian food 🥨🍺 Locals love it, tourists haven't found it yet. The Schweinebraten is perfect! #augustiner;#bavarianfood;#localspot;#authenticmunich
Rooftop pool at Bader Hotel 🏊‍♀️ Not cheap but wow the vibes!  City views, cocktails, and a heated pool. Treat yourself! #badhotel;#rooftoppool;#luxurymunich;#poolday
Gasteig HP8 reopened and it's amazing!  🎭 Concerts, exhibitions, rooftop bar. The new cultural heart of Munich! #gasteig;#culturecenter;#munichculture;#livemusic
Hidden garden at Hofgarten 🌳 Escape the crowds and find peace in the arcades.  Brings a book and chill!  #hofgarten;#garden;#peacefulplace;#munichparks
Christmas lights walking tour 🎄✨ Start at Marienplatz, walk through Kaufingerstraße, end at Odeonsplatz. The whole city sparkles! #christmaslights;#munichChristmas;#walkingtour;#december
Dinner at Atelier 🍽️ 3 Michelin stars and every course is art.  Splurge-worthy for a special celebration! #atelier;#michelinstars;#finedining;#munichfood
Ice skating at Olympiapark ⛸️ Outdoor rink, fairy lights, hot chocolate. Peak winter activity! #iceskating;#olympiapark;#winterfun;#december
Sunday flea market at Riem Arcaden 🛍️ Vintage fashion, antiques, random treasures. Cash only!  #fleamarket;#riemarcaden;#vintage;#sundaymarket
Morning coffee at Man vs Machine ☕ Third wave coffee done right. The baristas are super knowledgeable!  #manvsmachine;#specialtycoffee;#coffeelover;#munichcafe
Brunch buffet at Käfer-Schänke 🥐🍾 A bit fancy but the quality is amazing. Champagne included! #kaferschanke;#brunch;#buffet;#fancybrunch
Silent disco at Tollwood 🎧 Dance with headphones, switch between 3 DJs.  Hilarious and so much fun! #silentdisco;#tollwood;#munichparty;#uniqueexperience
Blumeninsel in the Isar 🌸 A tiny island full of wildflowers. Wade across (carefully!) for a mini adventure!  #blumeninsel;#isar;#hiddenmunich;#nature
Praterinsel at sunset 🌅 Bring a portable speaker and some drinks. Perfect spot for a summer evening with friends! #praterinsel;#isar;#sunset;#summernights
Chocolate heaven at Beluga 🍫 Handmade pralines, hot chocolate that'll change your life. Perfect gift shopping spot! #beluga;#chocolate;#pralines;#sweettreats
Climbing at Kletterzentrum München 🧗‍♀️ Indoor walls up to 18m high. Great workout and super fun! #climbing;#kletterzentrum;#indoorclimbing;#fitness
Sunset picnic at Olympiaberg 🧺🌇 Bring wine and cheese, watch the sky change colors. Free and romantic! #olympiaberg;#picnic;#sunset;#romanticmunich
Starnberger See day trip 🚂💙 Take the S-Bahn, rent a bike, ride around the lake. Perfect weekend escape! #starnbergersee;#daytrip;#lake;#bikeride
Dinner at Tantris 🍽️ Legendary restaurant with 2 Michelin stars. The wine pairing is exceptional! #tantris;#michelinstar;#finedining;#munichgourmet
Techno night at Harry Klein 🎶 Best electronic music club in Munich. Dress code is chill, vibes are immaculate! #harryklein;#techno;#nightclub;#munichnight
Pinakothek der Moderne on a Sunday 🎨 Only €1 admission!  Modern art, design, architecture. Budget-friendly culture day! #pinakothekdermoderne;#modernart;#sundaymuseum;#budgetmunich
Morning pastry at Zeit für Brot 🥐 The cinnamon bun is HUGE and amazing. Always fresh from the oven! #zeitfurbrot;#pastry;#cinnamonbun;#breakfast
Seafood at Austernkeller 🦞 Fresh oysters, lobster, champagne.  Fancy date night sorted! #austernkeller;#seafood;#oysters;#datenight
Graffiti hunting in Giesing 🎨 So many cool pieces on the walls. Urban art at its finest! #giesing;#graffiti;#streetart;#urbanmunich
Botanical Garden in spring 🌺 Greenhouses full of tropical plants, quiet paths, total zen. Free entry after 4: 30pm! #botanischergarten;#garden;#plants;#peacefulmunich
Glühwein crawl 🍷✨ Hit Marienplatz, Wittelsbacher Platz, and Sendlinger Tor markets in one night.  Festive chaos! #gluhweincrawl;#christmasmarket;#munichChristmas;#winterfun
Best burger at Holy Burger 🍔 Juicy patties, homemade buns, crispy fries. Simple and perfect! #holyburger;#burger;#munichfood;#burgertime
Skate session at Hirschgarten 🛹 Huge park with smooth paths.  Bring your board and roll! #hirschgarten;#skateboarding;#park;#munichskate
Lenbachhaus art museum 🖼️ Blue Rider collection is stunning. The garden courtyard is perfect for a coffee break! #lenbachhaus;#art;#museum;#munichculture
Late breakfast at Cotidiano 🥞☕ Their French toast with berries is heaven. Book ahead on weekends! #cotidiano;#breakfast;#frenchtoast;#munichbrunch
Sushi at Sushi Sano 🍣 Small place, big flavors. Book in advance, it fills up fast! #sushisano;#sushi;#japanesefo od;#munichsushi
Open-air cinema at Kino am Olympiasee 🎬 Bring a blanket, watch a movie under the stars. Summer magic! #kinoamolympiasee;#openaircinema;#summernight;#movienight
Bookshop & café at Lost Weekend 📚☕ Browse English books, drink great coffee.  Cozy vibes for book lovers! #lostweekend;#bookshop;#cafe;#booklover
Sunday morning at Müllersches Volksbad 🏊‍♂️ Swim in a historic Art Nouveau pool. Feels like time travel! #mullerschesvolksbad;#swimming;#artnouveau;#sundayswim
Vegan brunch at Gratitude 🌱 Even non-vegans will love it! The pancakes and smoothie bowls are incredible!  #gratitude;#veganbrunch;#plantbased;#munichvegan
Pub quiz night at Keg's 🍻 Tuesdays at 8pm. Bring a team, test your trivia knowledge, win beer! #kegs;#pubquiz;#trivianight;#munichpub
Fountain courtyard at Maximilianeum 🏛️ Not many tourists know about this spot. Beautiful architecture and so quiet! #maximilianeum;#courtyard;#hiddenmunich;#architecture
Pizza at O Fiore Mio 🍕 Neapolitan style, fluffy crust, simple toppings. Some of the best in Munich! #ofioremio;#pizza;#neapolitan;#munichpizza
Rooftop sunset at Goldene Bar 🌅🍸 Inside Haus der Kunst, stunning views, chic crowd. Perfect pre-dinner drinks! #goldenebar;#rooftop;#hausderkunst;#sunsetdrinks
Laser tag at LaserZone 🎮 Surprisingly fun even as an adult! Great rainy day activity with friends.  #laserzone;#lasertag;#indoorfun;#friendsnight
Tea time at Teehaus im Englischen Garten 🍵 Japanese tea house by the lake. Zen vibes and matcha perfection! #teehaus;#englischergarten;#matcha;#teahouse
Farmers market at Elisabethmarkt 🥕🍎 Less touristy than Viktualienmarkt, super authentic. Go on Saturday mornings! #elisabethmarkt;#farmersmarket;#localproduce;#munichmarkets
Wine bar at Vinothek Geisel 🍷 Huge selection, knowledgeable staff, cozy atmosphere. Wine lover's paradise! #vinothekgeisel;#winebar;#munichw ine;#winelovers
Sauna session at Müller'sches Volksbad 🧖‍♂️ Old-school sauna with Isar river views. Relaxing and historic! #sauna;#mullerschesvolksbad;#wellness;#relaxation
Sunset walk along Nymphenburg canal 🌅 Perfectly symmetrical, super photogenic. Best in golden hour! #nymphenburg;#canal;#goldenhour;#munichwalks
Craft cocktails at Zephyr Bar 🍹 Creative drinks, dim lighting, great music. My favorite cocktail spot in Munich! #zephyrbar;#cocktails;#glockenbachviertel;#nightlife
Tacos at El Bandido 🌮 Authentic Mexican in the heart of Munich. The al pastor is a must-try! #elbandido;#tacos;#mexicanfood;#munichtacos
Yoga in Olympiapark 🧘‍♀️ Free outdoor classes on Sunday mornings in summer.  Bring your mat and join!  #yoga;#olympiapark;#outdooryoga;#freemunich
Vintage shopping in Glockenbachviertel 👗 So many cute boutiques.  Found amazing 90s pieces! #vintageshop;#glockenbachviertel;#fashion;#munichshopping
Lunch at Wirtshaus in der Au 🍖 Old-school Bavarian restaurant. The Schweinshaxe is massive and delicious! #wirtshausau;#bavarianfood;#schweinshaxe;#traditionalmunich
Michelin-worthy lunch at Les Deux 🍽️ French bistro with excellent tasting menu. Book ahead! #lesdeux;#frenchfood;#bistro;#munichgourmet
Comedy night at Lustspielhaus 😂 Great lineup of English stand-up.  Tickets sell out fast! #lustspielhaus;#comedy;#standup;#munichcomedy
Morning walk through Alter Botanischer Garten 🌳 Tiny park but so charming. Great shortcut between neighborhoods! #alterbotanischergarten;#park;#morningwalk;#munichgreen
Breakfast bagels at Vorstadt-Café ☕🥯 Fluffy bagels, strong coffee, friendly staff. My go-to morning spot! #vorstadtcafe;#bagels;#breakfast;#munichcafe
Dim sum at Little Osaka 🥟 Fresh and flavorful!  The har gow and siu mai are perfect.  #littleosaka;#dimsum;#asianfood;#munichdimsum
Late night pizza at L'Osteria 🍕 Huge pizzas, lively atmosphere, always packed. Go for the vibes! #losteria;#pizza;#latenight;#munichfood
Sunset from Monopteros temple 🌅 Iconic viewpoint in Englischer Garten.  Bring a blanket and watch the city glow! #monopteros;#englischergarten;#sunset;#viewpoint
Indian food at Desi Fusion 🍛 Best butter chicken in Munich! Generous portions and great prices. #desifusion;#indianfood;#butterchicken;#munichcurry
Cheese tasting at Andy's Krablergarten 🧀🍷 Outdoor garden, amazing cheese plates, local wines. Summer perfection! #andyskrablergarten;#cheese;#winebar;#munichgarden
Beach volleyball at Flaucher 🏐 Free courts by the river.  Bring a ball and jump in! #beachvolleyball;#flaucher;#isar;#summersport
Morning pastries at Hofpfisterei 🥐 Traditional Bavarian bakery. Their dark bread is legendary! #hofpfisterei;#bakery;#bread;#munichbakery
Hidden courtyard at Fünf Höfe 🏛️ Beautiful modern architecture, designer shops, peaceful oasis in the city center!  #funfhofe;#shopping;#architecture;#hiddenmunich
Steak night at Grill Royal Munich 🥩 Perfectly cooked, amazing sides, great atmosphere. Worth the splurge! #grillroyal;#steak;#finedining;#munichsteak
Karaoke night at Little London Bar 🎤 Private booths, huge song selection, cheap drinks. So much fun! #karaoke;#littlelondonbar;#nightout;#singing
Peaceful morning at St. Johann Nepomuk (Asam Church) ⛪ Baroque masterpiece that most people miss.  Free entry!  #asamkirche;#baroque;#church;#municharchitecture
Afternoon at Café Cord 🍰☕ Vintage décor, amazing cakes, strong coffee.  Feels like your grandma's living room! #cafecord;#vintage;#cake;#munichcafe
Modern German at Broeding 🍽️ 7-course tasting menu changes weekly. Creative, delicious, unforgettable!  #broeding;#tastingmenu;#germancuisine;#munichfine
